messages:
laura: Quick sync: Legal wants a shorter migration note & engineering wants airtight snippet tests before we push redirects. We need a tiny checklist: canonical migrate page, snippet CI, compat smoke tests, analytics tag. Can we short-circuit this into a single PR chain?

Tom: yes. propose: 1) docs PR for migrate page + snippets (single commit), 2) a docs-ci workflow that runs example snippets (node, python, go) in a matrix, 3) ops smoke job that verifies /docs/v1/* -> /docs/v2/compat/* resolve with ?migrate=v1 tag.

nina: I'll rewrite all JS/TS examples to use the v2 shape and add notes about parameter renames. Also will add small unit-run snippets that can be executed in CI (no real keys).

jeff: For snippet CI we should use a sandbox key fixture and a playbook of expected responses (snapshot). GH Actions matrix is fine. Also add a lint rule that rejects snippets that still contain "model_id" in JS.

laura: good. can you sketch the GH Action snippet? keep it minimal.

Tom: GH Action draft:
```yaml
name: docs-snippet-test
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  snippet-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        lang: [node, python, go]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup ${{ matrix.lang }}
        run: ./scripts/setup-${{ matrix.lang }}.sh
      - name: Run examples
        run: ./scripts/run-examples.sh ${{ matrix.lang }}
```

nina: scripts/run-examples.sh will run quick smoke calls against a local mock server that returns canned responses, so no secrets. I have a simple mock harness ready.

jeff: Add an expectation: examples should produce valid JSON with a top-level "choices" array or an embeddings vector. Snapshot assert is enough. If a snippet changes shape, CI fails and we attach the failing snippet line for authors.

laura: ops needs a one-liner curl they can run for the staged redirect smoke test. tom?

Tom: sure: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n" "https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/v1/guides/abc" -L` should end with /docs/v2/compat/guides/abc?migrate=v1 and 302 during staging. We'll include that in the PR description.

nina: I'll open a docs PR with the rewritten snippets and GH Action. PR will include a tiny note in the migrate page: "If you see Authorization issues, strip whitespace and use exact 'Bearer <token>' format." and a short Go example:```go
// normalize Authorization header
req.Header.Set("Authorization", strings.TrimSpace("Bearer "+token))
```

jeff: also add a doc-lint rule: `docs-lint` should flag any example that uses old endpoint `/api/v1/` or old param `model_id`. We can run that in the same workflow before running snippets.

pr-bot: PR opened by @nina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7890 — Migrate page + snippet-runner + docs-ci workflow.

laura: thanks. nina, can you add a short QA checklist in the PR: unit-run snippets pass in GH Actions, doc-lint passes, staging curl validated, analytics param observed for 24h?

nina: yes — I'll add that checklist. ETA PR by EOD today.

Tom: i'll add the staging smoke job as an ops task and link OPS ticket in the PR. ops can run the curl and check logs for `migrate=v1` traffic.

pr-bot: Task OPS-4210 created: staged-redirect-smoke (assigned to tom).

jeff: one more: let's make snippet CI annotate the failing code block with a comment like "SNIPPET_FAIL: line 34" so authors can quickly find it. GH Actions supports annotations.

laura: perfect. once PR merges, ops will stage 302 redirects for two weeks and we flip to 301 later. keep thread updated with PR/OPS links. closing the loop here — thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
